messages.subject: INLA version 23.05.22  && R-4.2
parts:
The new testing version 23.05.22 will be the last one built with R-4.2,
and we'll now move to R-4.3

The new features includes

* Reduced memory usage for data-rich models
* Added new option `control.compute=list(save.memory=FALSE|TRUE)` for
more agressive savings

H
